title: Canonical section transport through a factorization of scheme maps
statement: Let $X,Y,Z$ be schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $g:Y\to X$, $h:Z\to X$ and $v:Z\to Y$ with $v;g=h$. For an $\mathcal O_X$-module $M$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], define $T_{g,h,v}:\Gamma(g^*M)\to\Gamma(h^*M)$ as the pullback adjunction unit along $v$ followed by the canonical composition comparison $v^*g^*M\cong h^*M$. This is the explicit constructed section map pullbackSectionFactorization.

def pullbackSectionFactorization
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) (h : Z ⟶ X) (v : Z ⟶ Y)
    (hv : v ≫ g = h) (M : X.Modules) :
    Γ((pullback g).obj M, ⊤) → Γ((pullback h).obj M, ⊤)
